name: DeepSeek
summary: Chinese lab offering open-weight LLMs, a free chat app and a low-cost API.
description: DeepSeek develops large language models and publishes open-weight models such as DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V4, usable for chat, reasoning and coding. Its differentiator is open weights combined with very low API prices, with off-peak discounts. Chatting in the web and mobile app is free; the API is pay-as-you-go, e.g. from $0.15 per million input tokens (cache miss, off-peak) on the current pricing table.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: from $0.15 per million input tokens (cache miss, off-peak) on the current pricing table.

howToUse.title: Chat on the web or in the app
howToUse.description: The homepage links the DeepSeek web version, an app download, and a chat entry labeled in Chinese as talking with DeepSeek. Chatting in the web and mobile app is the path the homepage offers.

howToUse.title: Or open the API platform
howToUse.description: The same page links the API platform. The API docs say to apply for an API key and call https://api.deepseek.com, using the model name deepseek-flash.

howToUse.title: Use it from an agent tool
howToUse.description: Those docs say Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode can use DeepSeek as the backend model.
